verses.text: 506. Mary is a virgin because her virginity is the sign of her faith “unadulterated by any doubt”, and of her undivided gift of herself to God’s will. (LG 63; cf. 1 Cor 7:34-35.) It is her faith that enables her to become the mother of the Saviour: “Mary is more blessed because she embraces faith in Christ than because she conceives the flesh of Christ.” (St. Augustine, De virg. 3: PL 40, 398.)
